title: Modern Classic Hypixel
description: Reverts changes made in recent Minecraft versions. Made for Hypixel
body:
Changes a few things to make Hypixel (Skyblock) feel more like 1.8.

Features:
- Remove the weak attack, flatten, and small fall sounds
- Replace piglin sounds with zombified piglin sounds
  - This reverts a bug where zombified piglin sounds are replaced with piglin sounds.
- Rescale and reposition heads in the inventory and hand to (approximately) match 1.8
  - Heads in third person are unaffected, as changing that would mess up pets.
- Bring back old spawn eggs (up to 1.8 + polar bear) and dyes
- Bring back old slot highlight texture
- Bring back old inventory ui without offhand or recipe book (visually; the functionality will still be there)
- Reverted some unicode characters to their 1.8 versions
- Bring back old villager professions - Villagers still use 1.14 textures outside their professions
  - This does not affect professions added in 1.14.

Planned:
- Revert more unicode characters

If you would like to help me add to this pack or give me suggestions, feel free to message me on Discord @dolphin002!
